messages:
Devon: Heads up — saw a 12-18% p99 latency regression on some Mistral/Mixtral routes after the kernel-selector tweak yesterday. Repro on seq=2048. Anyone else seeing this?
Marie: Yep, hit the same on Qwen-14B traffic. Looks correlated with models where head_dim % 8 != 0 — selector is sending them down a different path. @Sachin can you look? :eyes: 
Sachin: On it. Quick hypothesis: when head_dim % 8 != 0 and seq > 1024 the selector prefers the Triton SDPA fallback which is slower and interacts poorly with our prefix/KV cache. Profiling now.
Devon: Adding a small profiler dump I grabbed from canary:
```
[2025-03-15 09:21:03] model=mistral-7B variant=mixtral head_dim=77 seq=2048 kernel=sdpa_triton latency=12.4ms tokens=512 cache_hit=false
[2025-03-15 09:21:03] model=qwen-14B head_dim=80 seq=2048 kernel=flash_attn latency=3.1ms tokens=512 cache_hit=true
[2025-03-15 09:21:05] model=mistral-7B head_dim=77 seq=2048 kernel=sdpa_triton latency=11.9ms tokens=512 cache_hit=false
```
Marie: Interesting — cache_hit=false spikes on the sdpa_triton runs. I also saw higher KV-cache churn (eviction/rehash) when the slowpath is chosen, maybe due to different mask alignment code.
Devon: Repro steps I used: `curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{"model":"mistral-mixtral","max_tokens":512,"input":"<~300 tokens>"}'` on canary. I can share full trace files.
Sachin: Workarounds: 1) force `kernel=flash_attn` for those models (risky, may crash for odd heads), 2) add a pad-to-8 head shim in compilation so Flash can be selected, or 3) patch selector to avoid SDPA_triton when prefix_cache_enabled=true and seq > 1024. Option 3 seems lowest-risk.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolled back kernel-selector change on canary (deployment id: canary-20250315-42) at 1758429200 :white_check_mark:
Marie: Canary rollback removed the latency spike on the quick sweep. I'll run a larger KV-cache stress run: `scripts/perf/run_kv_cache_sweep.sh --models mistral-7b,qwen-14b --seq 2048 --iters 200`
Devon: I'll open an infra issue with the reproducer and attach the A100 traces + perf traces. We should also add a CI perf test that exercises seq 2048 / odd head dims.
Sachin: Plan: implement selector guard to prefer flash path if `prefix_cache_enabled && seq > 1024` and add a small padded-flash kernel in parallel. Will send a PR with benchmark numbers by EOD tomorrow. If we still need SDPA_triton we should add explicit KV-cache compatibility tests for mask/padding.
Marie: Also add a regression alert: if p99 increases by >8% after kernel selection changes, fail the canary gate.
Devon: Good. Also flag any customer incidents that saw errors — I'll populate a short list to watch.
Sachin: FYI, found a tiny mask-handling discrepancy in Triton SDPA where `mask_len % warp_size` branch causes an extra memcpy path. Patching now, will include test vectors.
Marie: Nice catch. :+1: Once the guard + test are in, we can re-roll the selector change behind a feature flag and run a broad perf sweep.
Devon: Thanks all — keep updates in this thread and drop the PR links here.
